name.my: ထမင်း + ကြက်သားဟင်း

method: One curry-shop plate: 1½ plates of rice, 4 spoons of chicken curry, a spoon of ngapi yay and raw vegetables.
notes: Drafted by Claude from general knowledge (2026-11-01); not yet checked against published recipes. Weigh real plates from a few curry shops. Named for its chicken curry (2026-11-03) so people with another curry log rice and that curry instead.
